claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.grantedSpellOptionRestriction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current spell-grant override surface can change DC, area, targeting, and duration, but it cannot narrow a granted spell to only a subset of its allowed cast-time options. The wand's Command cast is restricted to two command words, so unrestricted grant_spell_access would mis-state the item.
